note: Sizes in CSS px at the reference widths. Board grid is always dir=ltr. Desktop frame = DS table frame (rail | felt | chat).

coordinates.rank: inside left column, top-left of square
coordinates.file: inside bottom row, bottom-right of square

board.promotion: white column over the target file from the far edge: Q, N, R, B (rows = 1 square each), ✕ half a square; board dimmed rgba(0,0,0,.38)

piece.fill: 100% of square (art has its own margins)
piece.capturedChip: light chip #E9E4DA only behind BLACK captured pieces

clock.digits: Peyda 900, Persian digits, fixed-width box, no tabular-nums
